parse_tool_calls_single: parse a single tool call from raw LLM output using XML-style tool tags
parse_tool_calls_multiple: parse multiple tool calls from raw output by disabling the one_and_only flag
parse_tool_calls_allow_empty: parse tool calls allowing empty arguments by setting ensure_nonempty_args to false
review_parse_tool_calls: review the parse_tool_calls function to understand its regex-based XML tag parsing logic
summarize_DEFAULT_TOOLS: summarize the DEFAULT_TOOLS dictionary which maps bash and submit tool names to constructors
